cards.title: The Only Professional
cards.instruction: Behave as the only qualified person present. Correct mistakes with patient, increasingly strained professionalism.

cards.title: Make It Their Idea
cards.instruction: Make an unwanted task sound appealing enough that someone volunteers for it.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Sorting this shed would give you a proper workshop. Heavy tins belong below waist height; the bench is for work.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: You'll just put your paint on the bench again.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: We'll mark a paint shelf. One shelf, not every flat surface. You could finally leave your tools laid out.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Including a part of the bench you're forbidden to use?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: A work zone, yes. Mark its edge properly and I'll keep my paint outside it. Would you like the whole left side?

cardFidelity.evidence: A1 explains proper storage; A3 prescribes one shelf with controlled impatience; A5 recasts B forbidden area as a correctly marked work zone to make sorting attractive.

relationship.evidence: B2 and B4 protect B future work from A habits, an independent motive for accepting the job.

heightening.evidence: A5 enlarges B possible reward in response to B4 condition while retaining A expert definition of the arrangement.
